data.body:
Root cause: material_fingerprint (pass1.py) hashed the raw description, so the box-flip that 433c's close precheck REQUIRES read as a material edit -> stale-material -> forced re-review before every close (observed on d3ed/433c/9d07/a584 closes).

Fix pushed as Gerrit change 1262: _normalize_checkbox_state erases box STATE (line-anchored, -/* bullets, x/X) before hashing; item text stays material. Both staleness consumers (plan-review close gate + completion-verifier stale-material) recompute through this one seam via current_material_fingerprint, so one normalization covers both. Pinned-literal fingerprint tests unchanged (review-time descriptions are unchecked -> byte-identical basis). 3 RED tests first (unit invariance x2, store-level attestation validity), mutation-checked (line-dropping over-normalization killed by item-text-edit + indent tests). 206 neighborhood tests green.

Until 1262 merges, closes on stores driven by pre-fix builds still trip stale-material; workaround remains re-running review-plan before close.
